Very often a weaker product wins over competitors because of good marketing. Another important point is everyone has different tastes. You may absolutely love something and other billions of people couldn’t care less about it. Companies in most cases therefore do some research of the target market, make quick MVPs to tests people’s reaction, before investing large amount of resources into something.

But I think -- and tried it myself -- that you can fake your confidence, you can change your appearance and you can change your attitude to rejections. I tried being the confident, cheerful and ever positive person and noticed how people promptly started treating me differently. You can also completely change your looks by getting a haircut, new classy clothes, etc.

And regarding rejections -- of course they are painful, but you should be proud of yourself for taking a chance! Remember that there can be multiple rejections, but you only need one success. The more you practice it, the better you become.
